generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be Registered Electrical contractor license issued by the Electrical Inspectorate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Electrical License Registration Certificate issued by the Electrical Inspectorate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be Registered KPWD Civil contractor of Class IV and above

ITT 3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (a) Achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering works only) of Rs. 17.83 Lakhs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should furnish GST Registration Certificate.

The bidder should furnish the statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed & should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. If no existing commitments / ongoing-works, a Nil certificate shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish the statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works

technicalCriterionList.description: Eligible tenders will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. (Refer standard tender documents section-2: A General Instructions to tenders), for that the supporting documents shall be uploaded failing which the tender will not be considered.

Company Registration Certificate /Class IV & Above KPWD Registration Certificate
